title: crontick markdown card data file
description: Data file (data.json) for a markdown card: the data key is bound to the markdown payload. Not expressible in JSON Schema, enforced by the validator: data must be an object unless error is a non-empty string; error "" is treated as null (default null); updatedAt must be an RFC 3339 timestamp with offset or Z. When error is set the payload is not validated. The generic data.json leaves the payload open; the validator applies the per-type payload schema chosen by the card type.

data.title: crontick markdown card data
data.description: Not expressible in JSON Schema: none beyond the text length limit.
